title: DonutCraft SMP
description: A Server focused around war and peace.
body:
This is a server featuring mods focused around **warfare**, **industrialization**, and **automation**, alongside a decent amount of **Optimization** and **QoL** Mods.

Notable mods are Create, Clockwork, Valkyrien, Mekanism, Farmers delight, Auto Mobility, and Deeper and Darker.
NOTE: This modpack has been made for the DonutWT Discord server found here -> [DonutWT](https://discord.gg/donutwt)
If you are intrested in joining their Modded Minecraft Server, join the discord server and go to 
#mc-server-info
For information on how to join. Happy Mining!
